<noinclude>
This is the "Personnel" form.

To create a page with this form, enter the page name below;
if a page with that name already exists, you will be sent to a form to edit that page.

{{#forminput:form=Personnel|autocomplete on category=Personnel}}
</noinclude>
<includeonly>
<div id="wikiPreview" style="display: none; padding-bottom: 25px; margin-bottom: 25px; border-bottom: 1px solid #AAAAAA;"></div>

{{{for template|Personnel}}}

{| class="formtable"
|-
! Name:
| {{{field|name|mandatory|input type=text|size=50}}}
|-
! Role:
| {{{field|role|mandatory|input type=dropdown|values=PI,Postdoc,Graduate Student,Undergraduate Student,Research Assistant,Technician,Other}}}
|-
! Email:
| {{{field|email|mandatory|input type=email|size=50}}}
|-
! Start Date:
| {{{field|start_date|mandatory|input type=date}}}
|-
! Status:
| {{{field|status|mandatory|input type=dropdown|values=Active,Inactive,Alumni|default=Active}}}
|-
! Supervisor:
| {{{field|supervisor|input type=combobox|values from category=Personnel|autocomplete on property=Personnel Role}}}
|-
! Certifications:
| {{{field|certifications|input type=checkboxes|values from category=Safety Certification|delimiter=;}}}
|-
! Equipment Authorizations:
| {{{field|equipment_authorizations|input type=checkboxes|values from category=Equipment|delimiter=;}}}
|-
! Training Records:
| {{{field|training_records|input type=textarea|rows=5}}}
|}

{{{end template}}}

'''Free text:'''

{{{standard input|free text|rows=10}}}
</includeonly>
